title: US Coast Guard oversees Western Maui Wildfires Emergency Support Function #10 operation to dismantle and transfer fire-damaged tugboat to disposition lot in Lahaina, Hawaii
description: Response personnel dismantle and transfer a fire-damaged tugboat from the harbor to a nearby disposition lot, Nov. 8 and 10, 2023, in Lahaina, Hawaii. The Unified Command, comprised of the U.S. Coast Guard, Hawaii Department of Land and Natural Resources, and Hawaii Department of Health, contracted Global Diving and Salvage to conduct salvage and recovery operations at Lahaina Harbor in support of Western Maui Wildfires Emergency Support Function #10. (U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 2nd Class Brandon Hillard)
keywords: Coast Guard District 14, Lahaina, ESF 10, Maui Wildfires, Hawaii Wildfires 2023
